literal_meaning: ধরে রাখা বা ছোঁয়ার বাইরে (beyond grasp or touch)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জটিল তত্ত্ব আমার উপলব্ধির ধরাছোঁয়ার বাইরে।
example_sentences_in_english: The mysteries of God are beyond human grasp.
This complex theory is beyond my comprehension.
history: Often used in contexts referring to the divine or supreme being as beyond human understanding, rooted in philosophical discussions.
note: The idiom draws from concepts of the intangible divine in Bengali thought.
